title: Temperature converter with form card
request: Temperature converter between Celsius and Fahrenheit. '<number> C' replies '<number> C = <F> F' and '<number> F' replies '<number> F = <C> C', results rounded to 1 decimal. If no unit is given, reply 'Which scale?' with a form card that has a number field named 'value', a select field named 'scale' with options C and F, and a submit button whose selection is {"action":"convert"}. When the submitted form arrives as JSON (e.g. {"action":"convert","value":"100","scale":"C"}) convert it the same way.
